opportunities.name: Plan city trip and log summary note
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search Google Flights, Booking.com hotels, and Viator activity, then save a trip summary (flight, hotel, activity prices) as a note.
steps: Open Google Flights, set origin Paris, enter destination and dates, search
Open Booking, search destination with same dates, open top hotel and note price
Open Viator, search for the activity in the destination, open top result and note price
Open notes app and create a new note summarizing trip dates, flight, hotel and activity with prices

instances.values: Barcelona, Jan 20-24 2027, Sagrada Familia tour Barcelona

opportunities.description: Look up each of two PyPI packages (version, date, license, GitHub stars via repository link), then write a comparison note.
steps: Search PyPI for package A, open its page
Open the repository/source link and note stars
Create a note with version, release date, stars and license for both
